result.summary: The page is largely well-structured and visually consistent. The horizontal carousels (category chips, 'Fastest near you' cards) and the bottom-cut pizza card are expected scroll/viewport behaviors and not defects. One minor content issue was found: the third restaurant card's title ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped by the right screen edge.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated by the right screen edge. While partial visibility of the last carousel item is an accepted horizontal-scroll pattern, the title text itself is cut mid-word without an ellipsis, which looks slightly unpolished.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol…') to card titles so any clipped text degrades gracefully, or ensure the carousel item width accounts for the title length.
